links.passage: The Jevons Paradox, also known as the rebound effect, is a phenomenon in which implementing a more technically efficient natural resource technology, such as drip irrigation, results in an unexpected increase in the utilization of that natural resource rather than the intended decrease. This paradox has been observed in various contexts and has significant implications for sustainable resource management (Birkenholtz, 2017).
